baslik: The Autothrottle Everyone Thought Was Holding Speed

sahneler.metin: A Boeing 777 slammed into the seawall at San Francisco airport.
Its tail broke off, and three people were killed.
The approach had been too slow and too low.
The crew believed the autothrottle was holding speed.
It had been left in a mode that didn't.
The airspeed kept falling, and nobody noticed in time.
The go-around came seconds too late.
Training on automation modes was strengthened afterward.

aciklama:
Asiana 214 hit the seawall short of the runway in San Francisco. The cause: unintended autothrottle mode on a visual approach, letting airspeed decay unnoticed.
